cases.title: Robstown above-ground gas piping coating and atmospheric corrosion
cases.reason: Coating disbondment and pitting were observed, but water-path timing and saddle response were not measured.

cases.title: Nuiqsut above-ground gas line water beneath damaged coating
cases.reason: Water beneath damaged coating supports only a case-inspired open-water-path mechanism, not a measured saddle waveform or corrosion rate.

cases.title: Alaska Highway gas pig sending barrel rupture from internal corrosion
cases.reason: The current straight-pipe saddle model cannot convert internal barrel corrosion and fatigue to a precursor signal.

cases.title: Index 381 buried gas pipeline earth movement and girth weld failure
cases.source_location: Failure investigation and Index 381 RCA section 5.0
cases.reason: A spatial pipe-and-support/soil model is required before translating distant earth movement to a local saddle load.

cases.title: Simonette Lateral buried gas pipeline external corrosion rupture
cases.reason: Buried-pipe soil and cathodic-protection mechanisms do not establish a saddle wetness waveform or wall-loss estimate.

cases.title: Minell buried gas pipeline immediate tractor strike
cases.reason: The impact ruptured the pipe immediately; the report provides post-strike alarms, not a pre-failure saddle signal.
